main_text.p: אכף ܐܟܦ Syr. Sedulò, diligenter. Philip. 2. 20. Græce γνησίως, Germanè.
אכר ܐܟܪܐ Ch. & Syr. Agricola. Plur. אכרין emph. אכריא Agricolæ.
אכת ܐܟܬܐ Syr. Inimicitia. Sic habet exemplar antiquum Viennense. Tremellius legit per ב, ܐܟܬܐ, ac deducit ab Hebræo איבה Matt. 5. 23.
אל Ch. Deus. Est & Pronomen plurale, per Apocopam pro אלין.
אלא אלה Ch. ܐܠܐ Syr. Plangere, lamentari, ejulare. Pahel אלי Idem.
אליא, אליא Ch. & Syr. Lamentatio, lamentum, luctus, ejulatio.
אלא Ch. Funda, היכמא דרמי גבר אבנא באלא Sicut projicit aliquis lapidem in funda, Cant. 8. 5. Sic Hebræi interpretantur. Alii, In cervam. Regia legunt בארעא In terram.
אלא, אלא Chald. & Syr. Verùm, sed; sic est ex Græco ἀλλὰ: Item Nisi, si non; sic componitur ex אן & לא juxta quosdam. Sic Syre ܐܢ Si non, Matt. 18. 3. quod aliâs dicitur ܐܠܐ.
אליון, אליון Ch. Pollex, tâ manus, quàm pedis, Exod. 29.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek entries are transcribed from the scan with uncertain letters not individually verified; vocalisation marks and some Syriac forms may be imperfect. The "(20." at the right end of the Chald. Quercus line is a printed reference and is kept as printed. Final line may continue at the foot, cut off at the edge of the scan.
